detail.reason: These passes use a parameter type outside the serialized shader-parameter block set; the pass record itself is retained, but no parameter block exists in the dump.

detail.warning: [2026.11.15-08.37.02:317][302]LogD3D12RHI: Warning: RHICopyToStagingBuffer cannot be used on the RayTracing Accelleration structure FRayTracingScene::SceneBuffer
detail.reason: D3D12 emitted a staging-copy warning for the ray-tracing acceleration structure. The dump still contains a nonzero SceneBuffer payload for every descriptor; the warning is retained as a readback-path caveat, not silently dropped.

r.RHI.UniformBufferContentMap.Enable is read-only at runtime; it was set before uniform creation through the launcher startup ini and observed as true. The later runtime assignment was rejected by design and did not change the value.

gaps.detail: Per-pixel/per-thread shader choices and intermediate registers are not DumpGPU resources and are not fabricated from pass parameters.
Resources that are never referenced by an RDG pass, memoryless resources, and writable SkipTracking resources are outside the raw frame; absence is explicit, not silently filled.
Native uniform-buffer textures expose the CPU content map and offsets. Shader-local values not written to a uniform buffer are not recoverable.
